about: Released weights of the Greek letter reader (kit/letterread.py). Weights are not in git; kit.letterread.resolve_weights downloads a named model once into ~/.cache/scrolls-kit/letters (or $KIT_LETTER_WEIGHTS) and refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs. Every string the reader returns is model output, not a reading.

ink-lines.scope: Noncommercial ink-map line research. Lower error in the published PHerc. 1667 comparison with line positions and letter height given; not established as best for whole regions or photographs.

permissive.scope: CC BY weights for automatic page reads, photographs and uses requiring a permissive license. The whole-region comparison is unresolved; this profile is not a universal accuracy claim.

letters-v2-real.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (trained on lines built from ICDAR 2023 Greek letter crops, CC BY-NC 4.0, and Hell-Char, CC BY 4.0)

letters-v2-ccby.licence: CC BY 4.0 (trained on lines built from Hell-Char letter crops, which the Hell-Char authors license under CC BY 4.0, and from synthetic glyphs; no ICDAR 2023 data; credits in the model card)
